title: Identifier
description: JSON Schema for an identifier — a member of a set I equipped with an injection I -> surface (Bourbaki, Theory of Sets, Ch. II §3). The most basic value-layer primitive: a non-empty string that distinguishes its referent from others in I. The schema captures only the value-shape (a non-empty string); specific identifier kinds — name (kebab-case), URI, UUID, etc. — narrow this base via further pattern constraints or allOf compositions.
